#Bitcoin whales are quietly shifting positions on Binance — is the $65K level worth watching more closely?

$BTC is hovering near $65K, with Binance’s Whale Ratio stabilizing around 0.5. This suggests a steady rise in large deposits flowing back into the exchange. Since 2024, the metric has undergone a structural shift, moving up from the 0.2–0.3 range common in 2022–2023 to a new baseline of 0.4–0.5.

While whale inflows don’t always trigger immediate selling, increasing activity — especially amid stalled price momentum — could signal growing supply pressure ahead.

The key question remains: Can Bitcoin defend the $60K–$65K support zone as major players continue to accumulate?
